prompts.title: Perfume bottle hero shot
prompts.why: One product, one light change, one camera move: the model keeps the bottle sharp instead of inventing new props.

input.prompt: Luxury perfume commercial. A faceted glass perfume bottle with amber liquid stands on a black marble plinth. A slow arc of warm light sweeps across the glass, throwing caustic reflections onto the marble, while fine mist drifts behind the bottle. Slow push-in from a medium shot to a close-up of the cap. Sound: a soft airy swell and a single deep piano note. No people, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Sneaker splash, vertical
prompts.why: Vertical 9:16 with a single action beat fits Reels, Shorts, and TikTok ad slots.

input.prompt: Vertical product ad. A white running sneaker drops in slow motion onto a shallow puddle on a dark rooftop at night. Water bursts outward in a crown splash, droplets catch neon-blue rim light, then the shoe lands and the camera tilts up to a low hero angle. Sound: a heavy splash, a bass hit, and city ambience. No logos, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Metal logo reveal from a reference image
prompts.why: Telling the model to keep the letter shapes from @Image1 protects the mark while the scene around it moves.

input.prompt: @Image1 is the brushed-metal PY logo. Start on an extreme macro of the brushed metal surface, then pull back slowly as a thin line of white light travels along the edges of the letters and reveals the full logo on a black background. Keep the letter shapes and proportions exactly as in @Image1. Sound: a low cinematic whoosh and a deep bass hit when the logo is fully revealed. No other text.

prompts.title: Ice-cream summer spot from a first frame
prompts.why: Animating an existing product still keeps colors and composition; aspect_ratio auto follows the image.

input.prompt: The pastel ice-cream scoops slowly soften in warm summer light. A drip runs down the side of the yellow cone, sugar crystals sparkle and tumble across the white floor, and the camera glides slowly from left to right along the row of cones. Sound: light playful ukulele music and a soft crunch of sugar. No people, no subtitles.

prompts.title: Skincare ad with a spoken line
prompts.why: Quoted dialogue is generated as audio in the same pass, so a short voiceover needs no separate TTS step.

input.prompt: Vertical beauty ad in a bright bathroom with morning sun. Close-up of a glass dropper releasing a single drop of clear serum onto a fingertip, then the camera rises to a woman in her thirties smoothing it onto her cheek and smiling into the mirror. A calm female voiceover says, "Ten seconds in the morning. Glow all day." Soft water sounds and gentle ambient music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: 30-second single take: the harbor letter
prompts.why: Timestamped beats keep one subject and setting consistent across a full 30-second take. This is the text-to-video example from the PoYo API reference.

input.prompt: One continuous 30-second story of the same young woman in a yellow raincoat delivering a handwritten letter across a small seaside town at dawn. 0-6s: wide aerial shot of the sleepy harbor town, fishing boats rocking, soft morning light; she rides an old bicycle down a cobblestone hill. 6-12s: tracking shot beside her as she weaves past a fish market, seagulls lifting off, a vendor waves at her. 12-18s: low-angle shot as she climbs a steep stone staircase carrying the bicycle, breathing hard, the letter tucked in her pocket. 18-24s: she knocks on a blue door at the top; an elderly man opens it and she hands him the letter. 24-30s: close-up of the man reading, his eyes filling with tears; he smiles and says softly, "She remembered." Camera slowly pulls back to reveal the sunrise over the sea. Natural ambient sound: waves, gulls, bicycle bell, footsteps, gentle piano music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Red sports car in mountain rain
prompts.why: A single tracking move plus 'stays sharp and consistent throughout' holds the hero object steady through fast motion.

input.prompt: Tracking shot alongside a red sports car carving through a winding mountain road in heavy rain. The camera keeps pace beside the car as it leans into a tight curve, spray rising from the tires, rain streaking past, headlights cutting through low clouds, dark pine forest and wet asphalt reflecting the light. The same red car stays sharp and consistent throughout. Sound: engine roar rising through the gears, tires hissing on wet asphalt, steady rain. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Desert caravan, ultrawide
prompts.why: 21:9 plus a slow lateral move reads as a film establishing shot.

input.prompt: Ultrawide establishing shot of a camel caravan crossing towering sand dunes at golden hour. Long shadows stretch across the ripples, wind lifts fine sand from the dune crests, and the camera trucks slowly to the right, keeping the caravan small against the vast landscape. Sound: wind over sand, soft camel bells, a low cello drone. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Rain-soaked noir with dialogue
prompts.why: Lighting, wardrobe, and one quoted line give a complete scene in eight seconds.

input.prompt: Black-and-white film noir. A detective in a trench coat and fedora stands under a flickering streetlamp in the rain, lighting a match that briefly illuminates his tired face. He looks down the empty street and mutters, "She was never coming back." Slow push-in to a close-up as the match goes out. Sound: heavy rain, distant thunder, a lonely saxophone. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Underwater kelp forest
prompts.why: Naming light behavior (shafts, particles) and a slow pace gives calm, high-detail underwater footage.

input.prompt: A free diver glides slowly through a towering kelp forest, sunlight falling in shafts through the green water, small silver fish scattering as she passes and particles drifting in the light. The camera follows from behind and slightly below, then she turns and swims up toward the bright surface. Sound: muffled underwater ambience, gentle bubbles, a soft ambient pad. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Same fox, new world
prompts.why: One reference image with an explicit identity line ('the same fox, the same brass compass') carries the character into a new setting.

input.prompt: @Image1 is the red fox with the brass compass on a cord. The same fox walks through a snowy mountain village at night, past glowing windows and a wooden sled, stops, and looks back at the camera as snowflakes land on its fur. Keep its face, fur colors, and the brass compass exactly as in @Image1. Sound: crunching snow, distant bells, soft wind. No subtitles.

prompts.title: Motion transfer from a reference video
prompts.why: @Image1 sets who, @Video1 sets how it moves and how the camera follows. A reference video changes billing to output plus reference seconds.

input.prompt: Use @Image1 for the red fox with its brass compass. Follow the trotting rhythm and side-tracking camera of @Video1. The fox trots along a path in an autumn city park, orange leaves swirling around its paws, warm late-afternoon light. Sound: rustling leaves and distant city traffic. No subtitles.

prompts.title: Character plus an audio reference
prompts.why: Audio references must be paired with a reference image or video; give @Audio1 one job (rhythm and mood).

input.prompt: @Image1 is the red fox with the brass compass. The fox explores a quiet misty meadow at sunrise, pausing to sniff wildflowers and then bounding forward. Match the rhythm and mood of @Audio1 in the pacing of its movement. No subtitles.

prompts.title: Same musician, new stage
prompts.why: Describing the outfit and instrument from the reference reinforces identity when the location changes.

input.prompt: @Image1 is the bearded musician in the olive flannel shirt with his acoustic guitar. The same man sits on a rooftop at dusk with the city lights coming on behind him, strums the guitar, and sings softly, "Late train home, I'm on my way." Slow orbit from his side to the front. Sound: acoustic guitar, his voice, light city ambience. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Two references in one scene
prompts.why: Each reference gets a role and a position in the frame, so the two characters do not blend.

input.prompt: @Image1 is the bearded musician with his acoustic guitar; @Image2 is the red fox with the brass compass. At night in a pine forest, the musician sits on a log by a campfire on the left of the frame and plays a gentle melody, while the fox curls up on the right side, its ears twitching to the music. Firelight flickers on both. Slow push-in. Sound: crackling fire, acoustic guitar, crickets. No subtitles.

prompts.title: Surreal transition between two frames
prompts.why: Describe the change between the frames, keep aspect_ratio auto, and use two images of the same shape (both 1024x576 here).

input.prompt: Surreal match-cut transition: the pastel ice-cream scoops melt into a flowing wave of color across the white floor, the wave rises and hardens into coral walls, and the scene settles into the coral room where a man kneels beside a wooden table under a mosaic canopy. Smooth continuous camera, no cuts. Sound: a soft liquid swoosh that turns into a calm room tone.

prompts.title: Continue the motion from a first frame
prompts.why: A cheap 480p first-frame draft: describe what happens next, not what is already in the image.

input.prompt: The red fox lifts its head, sniffs the morning air, then breaks into a run and disappears between the ferns. The camera stays still as sunbeams shift through the mist. Soft birdsong and rustling leaves.

prompts.title: Finish the action in a still
prompts.why: Give the subject in the first frame a clear goal and an ending pose.

input.prompt: The man finishes fixing the chair leg, stands up, steps back to look at the table under the mosaic canopy, and nods with satisfaction as loose mosaic pieces on the floor flutter in a light breeze. Locked-off wide shot. Sound: a last tap of a mallet, footsteps, a soft breeze.

prompts.title: Bring a logo still to life
prompts.why: Four seconds at 480p is the cheapest Seedance 2.5 Flash request (74 credits): ideal for testing a motion idea.

input.prompt: A slow sweep of white light moves across the brushed-metal PY letters from left to right, catching the bevelled edges, while the camera drifts slightly closer. Keep the letters unchanged. Sound: a soft metallic shimmer. No other text.

prompts.title: Day-to-night time-lapse (bring your own frames)
prompts.why: Template: replace both URLs with a daytime and a nighttime photo of the same place, taken from the same position and with the same shape.

input.prompt: Locked-off time-lapse of the storefront: start from the daytime scene in the first frame, let the sky darken, the street lamps and shop lights turn on, and pedestrians blur past, and end exactly on the nighttime scene in the last frame. Soft city ambience.

prompts.title: Slow push-in on hands at work
prompts.why: 'The same pair of hands and the same bowl throughout' keeps the object stable during a slow push-in.

input.prompt: Close-up of a ceramicist's hands shaping wet clay on a spinning pottery wheel. Warm golden window light from the side, dust particles floating in the air, water glistening on the clay as the fingers press inward and the bowl rises and widens. Shallow depth of field, slow push-in, the same pair of hands and the same bowl throughout. Sound: the soft whir of the wheel, wet clay squelching, quiet studio ambience. No music, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Dolly zoom at a cliff edge
prompts.why: Name the move and its visible effect: the subject stays the same size while the background stretches.

input.prompt: Dolly zoom shot: a lone hiker in a red jacket stands at the edge of a sea cliff, framed from the waist up. The camera moves backward while zooming in, so the hiker stays the same size while the ocean and the cliffs behind her stretch and loom closer. Overcast light, wind whipping her hair. Sound: roaring wind, crashing waves far below, a rising tense string note. No subtitles.

prompts.title: Orbit around a chef plating
prompts.why: A 360-degree orbit around a fixed subject is one of the most reliable showcase moves.

input.prompt: Smooth 360-degree orbit around a chef in a white jacket plating a dessert at a stainless-steel counter in a dim restaurant kitchen. Tweezers place an edible flower, a spoon draws a swoosh of raspberry sauce, and steam rises from a nearby pan in the warm backlight. Sound: kitchen clatter, a sizzling pan, quiet jazz from a radio. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: FPV drone dive through a canyon
prompts.why: FPV language (dive, bank, skim) produces fast continuous motion without cuts.

input.prompt: FPV drone shot: the camera dives off the top of a jungle waterfall, follows the falling water down the cliff, banks hard through mist and rainbows, then skims low over a turquoise river winding through a narrow canyon. Fast, smooth, continuous flight with no cuts. Sound: rushing water, wind noise, a driving electronic beat.

prompts.title: Borrow a camera style from a reference video
prompts.why: @Video1 supplies the locked-off framing and time-lapse pacing; the prompt supplies a new subject. Billed seconds = 6 output + 10 reference.

input.prompt: Follow the locked-off framing and time-lapse pacing of @Video1. A closed red tulip in a clear glass jar on a sunny kitchen table slowly opens its petals over the course of the shot while the shadows of the window frame move across the table. Soft morning birdsong. No subtitles.

prompts.title: Selfie product review
prompts.why: 'Handheld selfie' plus casual dialogue gives native-looking UGC for paid social.

input.prompt: Handheld vertical selfie video: a woman in her twenties in a sunlit bathroom holds a small amber glass serum bottle up to the camera and says casually, "Okay, two weeks with this serum and my skin has never been this calm. Honestly, I'm obsessed." Natural slight camera shake, real room acoustics, faint birdsong outside the window. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Talking head from a portrait
prompts.why: Start from a real portrait as the first frame; the spoken line and the action that follows animate it.

input.prompt: The musician looks into the camera, smiles, and says, "This one's called Late Train Home." Then he looks down at the guitar and starts strumming a slow folk melody. The lamp light flickers warmly behind him. Sound: his voice, acoustic guitar, quiet room tone.

prompts.title: POV unboxing, hands only
prompts.why: Hands-only POV avoids face consistency issues and keeps the focus on the product.

input.prompt: Vertical POV shot looking down at a wooden desk: two hands slide open a matte black gift box, lift tissue paper, and pull out a pair of white wireless earbuds in a charging case, then flip the case open toward the camera. Daylight from a nearby window. Sound: paper rustling, the soft click of the case, a quiet excited "Oh, nice." No logos, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Two-person street interview
prompts.why: Assign each line to a named speaker so dialogue lands on the right face.

input.prompt: Vertical street interview on a busy city sidewalk in the afternoon. A young male interviewer holds a small microphone toward an older woman with silver hair and asks, "What's the best advice you've ever gotten?" She laughs and answers, "Never skip breakfast, and never skip a chance to dance." Handheld camera, natural light, passersby in the background. Sound: street ambience, their voices. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

prompts.title: Quick tutorial tip
prompts.why: A 480p draft for an explainer: one speaker, one demonstration, one line of advice.

input.prompt: A friendly chef in a home kitchen faces the camera, holds up a lemon, and says, "Roll it on the counter first and you'll get twice the juice." He presses the lemon under his palm, rolls it, cuts it, and squeezes it into a glass bowl. Medium shot, bright natural light. Sound: his voice, the knife on the board, juice dripping. No subtitles, no on-screen text.
